content: A aytma, ameẓri n wuř inu u taẓaǧit tenni ẓuǧeɣ ɣar AREBBI di ṭṭweɛ n Israil, aqa-tt ḥima ad ɣarsen tiři Tudart.
Aqa cehhdeɣ xasen aqa nitni ɣarsen cḍaret i AREBBI, maca břa tussna.
Maɣar war ssinen tasegda n AREBBI, maca arezzun ad ṭṭfen di tsegda n ixef nsen. S uya war sswaḍɛen ixef nsen i tsegda n AREBBI.
Minzi akemmeř n Ccariɛa netta d Lmasiḥ i tsegda i kuř ijjen i ittamnen.
Minzi Musa yura zi jjihet n tsegda di Ccariɛa:
“Wenni itteggen man aya, ad zzayes iddar.”
Maca tasegda tenni zi l’iman teqqar ammu:
“War teqqar deg wuř nnec: ‘Wi ɣa igaɛɛden ɣar ujenna uca ad issehwa Lmasiḥ?”
niɣ:
“Wi dd-ihwan deg weḥfur n řaxart, uca issgeɛɛed Lmasiḥ zi taddart n imettinen?”
Maca min ixs ad yini man aya xenni?
“Tamwarrit tudes i cek, aqa-t deg uqemmum nnec uřa deg wuř nnec. Wa d Awař n l’iman i zi nettbarreḥ.”
Mařa tcehded i Siditneɣ Yasuɛ s uqemmum nnec uca ad tamned s wuř nnec belli AREBBI issnekkar i-t zi taddart n imettinen, ad teddared.
Minzi uř i dayes ittamen ad ittwasegged, uca aqemmum i zzayes icehhden, ad iddar.
Minzi Tira Iqeddsen qqarent:
“Marra wi zzayes i ɣa yamnen, war ittseḍḥi ca.”
Minzi Netta war ittegg bu řfarz jar Wudayen d Iramiyyen, minzi Netta d Ijjen, SIDI nsen marra nni ittenfeyyaḍ řxar x marra inni xas dd-ittřaɣan.
“Minzi kuř ijjen wenni i ɣa iřaɣan s Yisem n SIDI, ad iddar.”
Mammec i ɣa řaɣan x Wenni di war uminen ca? Niɣ mammec ɣa yamnen deg Wenni mixef war sřin, niɣ mammec ɣa sřen, mařa uřa d ijj war zzayes ibarreḥ ca?
Mammec i ɣa barrḥen mařa war dd-ttwassekken? Am mammec tura:
“Mecḥař ḍarfen iḍaren n yinni ittbarrḥen s řehna, n yinni ittbarrḥen s tebratin tiṣebḥanin.”
Maca war iǧi marra ṭṭaɛen i ubarreḥ n Řexbar Aṣebḥan n L’Injil, minzi Icaɛya iqqar:
“A Sidi inu, wi ɣa yamnen di tebrat nneɣ?”
Aqa l’iman zeg usḥessi uca asḥessi zeg Wawař n AREBBI.
Maca ad iniɣ:
“Ma zeɛma nitni war sřin?”,
“Xzar, řḥess nsen iffeɣ-dd ɣar marra tammurt, uca awařen nsen ɣar tneggura n ddunect.”
Maca ad iniɣ:
“Ma Israil war tefhim ca man aya?”
Ɣar umezwar Musa inna:
“Ad daywem ggeɣ tusmi zeg ijj n řgens i war iǧin ca d řgens, uca s yijj n řgens i war ittᵉṭṭiɛen ad daywem ggeɣ axeyyeq.”
Uca Icaɛya izɛem ad yini:
“Aqa baneɣ-dd i yinni war xafi yarezzun, aqa ufin ayi inni war xafi isseqsan.”
Maca zi jjihet n Israil iqqar:
“Ass ikmeř sswiẓẓḍeɣ ifassen inu i ijj n řgens ittɛekksen, iɛeṣṣan.”
